svg.title: Yushi · China bird recognition
svg.desc: Locate birds, crop each one, then combine two visual models for species ranking. Added boxes must also pass the later species-confirmation gate; initial boxes may remain pending review. Confirmed / needs-review status follows the original branch; fusion updates the species ranking only.
